Definition: Annualized recurring revenue added in the period from new customers' first paid subscriptions, net of discounts; excludes expansion and renewals.
Formula / grain: Sum of first-invoice annualized subscription amount in USD at the booking-date rate, by close month. Grain: month, customer.
Live-pull method: BI explore revenue_engine, measure net_new_arr_usd, filter deal_type = New Business, dimension close_month. Use amount_usd_converted, never the raw amount field (it double-counts multi-year terms). Re-query for the value.
Reconciliation notes: CRM amount overstated multi-year deals by about 2x until the 2026-08 field fix; the warehouse wins. Weekly deltas are date-stamped, never differenced from two cumulative snapshots.
Related: R-02 Customer count. Consumed by the weekly leadership brief and forecast prep.

Definition: Number of distinct customers (logos) with an active paid subscription on the as-of date. Deployments (workspaces) are a different measure.
Formula / grain: Count distinct account_id where subscription_status = active and plan_tier is not free. Grain: day.
Live-pull method: Warehouse table billing.subscriptions_daily: count(distinct account_id) where as_of_date = today. Never report deployments (R-03) as customers. Re-query for the value.
Reconciliation notes: Canon Gap #1: the README and the sales storyboard disagreed because one counted logos and the other deployments. Both pages now point here.
Related: R-03 Active deployments; glossary entry Logo / Deployment.

Definition: Share of new workspaces reaching the activation event within 14 days of connecting a storefront. The activation event itself is not yet decided.
Formula / grain: activated_workspaces_14d divided by new_workspaces, by connection week.
Live-pull method: Data agent call product.activation(window=14d, definition=pending). Do not run until the glossary grounds the definition; report the coverage gap instead. Re-query for the value.
Reconciliation notes: Three teams compute three different rates today. Canon Gap #2 is accepted and awaiting the owner decision.

Definition: Closed-won share of closed opportunities where a named alternative was recorded.
Formula / grain: closed_won divided by (closed_won + closed_lost), where the competitor field is populated. Grain: month, alternative.
Live-pull method: CRM report Competitive outcomes, filter competitor is known. Caveat: the competitor field is populated on under a tenth of closed opportunities, so every win-rate claim is labeled directional. Re-query for the value.
Reconciliation notes: Do not promote to grounded until competitor-field coverage passes the agreed threshold.

Definition: Recurring revenue retained from the start-of-period customer cohort, excluding expansion.
Formula / grain: Start-of-quarter cohort ARR minus churn and contraction, divided by start-of-quarter cohort ARR. Grain: quarter, cohort.
Live-pull method: Not wired. The billing-to-warehouse cohort table does not exist yet. Report the coverage gap; never estimate.
Reconciliation notes: Stub rows stay stubs until their source system is wired and an owner is named in the same motion.
